styling_stack: Tailwind CSS + Shadcn UI + Native CSS Keyframe Animations

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-slate-900 leading-[1.1]
hierarchy.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900
hierarchy.subtitle: text-lg text-slate-600 leading-relaxed

provider_naming_rules.public_web_and_client_dashboard: STRICTLY BAN names like ElevenLabs, Zadarma, Vapi, OpenAI. Use generic high-end terms: 'Motor de Voz Ultra-Natural HD', 'Red Telefónica Directa España y Chile', 'Sintetizador de Voz Premium'.
provider_naming_rules.super_admin_panel: Allowed to show exact API providers (Zadarma, ElevenLabs, Vapi) for technical infrastructure management.

hero_redesign_strategy.concept: Tactical Live Call Studio (replaces generic AI gradient pills)
hero_redesign_strategy.eyebrow_badge: Live activity indicator: green pulsing dot + text 'Red Telefónica ES (+34) & CL (+56) Operativa'
hero_redesign_strategy.headline: Llamamos a tus leads web en menos de 30 segundos
hero_redesign_strategy.interactive_widget: Audio waveform call simulator with live audio trigger ('Escuchar llamada real') and typing transcript
hero_redesign_strategy.cta_lead_form: Solicita información ahora form with flag pills (🇪🇸 España / 🇨🇱 Chile), clean input shadows, and instant submission

css_keyframes.streamPulse: @keyframes streamPulse { 0%, 100% { opacity: 0.3; transform: scale(0.95); } 50% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1.1); } }

hover_effects.button: transition-all duration-200 ease-out hover:-translate-y-0.5 hover:shadow-md active:translate-y-0

landing_page.nav: Sticky glassmorphism header (bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-slate-200/80) with logo, quick links, ES/CL switch, and CTA
sections: Hero with Lead Form + Audio Wave Simulator
Trust Metrics Bar (<30s response, 98% lead reach)
Use Cases Grid (Recepcionista, Captura de Leads, Cobranzas, Agendamiento)
Footer with country support & clean branding

login_page.left_panel: Dark Slate background (#0F172A) with interactive live voice waveform preview card, real customer testimonial, and Spain/Chile trust badges
login_page.right_panel: Crisp White container with tabbed Auth (Iniciar Sesión / Registrarse), Google SSO button, float label inputs, and instant loading state

dashboard.sidebar: Clean light sidebar (bg-white border-r border-slate-200) with active blue pill highlights and clear icons
dashboard.topbar: Light topbar showing current balance, call minutes indicator, notifications, and profile dropdown
dashboard.widgets: Cardless borders (border border-slate-200 bg-white rounded-xl shadow-xs p-6) for high data clarity

testing_requirements.data_testid_rule: MANDATORY: All interactive elements, form inputs, submit buttons, tabs, and key metrics must include unique data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='login-email-input').
